instagram: developers.facebook.com → Create App → use case “Instagram API with Instagram Login”
Instagram → API setup with Instagram login → Business login settings: add the Redirect URL below
Copy the Instagram App ID and Secret into the fields below
threads: developers.facebook.com → Create App → use case “Access the Threads API”
Use cases → Threads → Settings: add the Redirect Callback URL below
Copy the Threads App ID and Secret into the fields below
linkedin: developer.linkedin.com → Create app (needs a company page — any of yours will do)
Products: add “Sign In with LinkedIn using OpenID Connect” and “Share on LinkedIn”
Auth: add the Redirect URL below, copy the Client ID and Secret into the fields below
x: developer.x.com → Projects & Apps → your app → User authentication settings
OAuth 2.0, Type of App: Web App; Callback URI — the address below; Website URL — any of yours
Keys and tokens → copy the OAuth 2.0 Client ID and Secret into the fields below
